statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-48054 was reported against LocalStack 2.3.2 as missing SSL certificate validation in OpenSearch/Elasticsearch cluster communication. Published advisory data scopes the vulnerable package range to pre-4.x LocalStack releases; this image ships LocalStack 4.14.0, which is outside the affected range.
